summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market share purchases under its existing buyback programme announced 20 May 2025. In the week 22-26 June 2026 it bought 7,084 ordinary shares at an average of €26.17-27.34 and 303,158 ADSs at ~$31.10-32.40 per share, all for cancellation. The board previously authorized the programme; no financial advisor is named. The purchases comply with EU MAR Article 5(1)(b). Watch: continued deployment of excess cash and pace of cancellation relative to the programme's expiry.
